alternate.convention: R8/R11 broad oscillation: switching every 16 decisions (32 logical frames); one decision is one two-frame advance

random.note: a fresh Random(seed) per world, so every world sees the same eighty-candidate stream

baselines.weak_definition: TacticalTeacher().decide(world, frame 0).action repeated for the whole horizon and projected onto the supported candidate with the same mask; one privileged query, not a label

criterion.loop: unchanged R11 semantics: mask the eighteen logits onto the six supported candidates, argmax, project candidate -> two-frame action, advance the real world, sticky collision, continue to the full horizon 160; a non-learning baseline needs no pixels
criterion.feasible: full horizon and no collision and (F3 only) canonical x <= goal at some sampled state, identical to R11 run_event
criterion.world_valid: all five non-learning baselines fail AND the weak teacher-first baseline fails AND the independent reference solver returns a complete action sequence that replays to feasible without early termination
criterion.world_invalid: at least one of the six baselines is feasible (the world is too easy)
criterion.world_unknown: all six baselines fail but no reference witness exists (bounded program search); unknown is discarded and is never reported as unsolvable
criterion.reference: tactical_teacher_validation.solve (independent bounded program class, no teacher geometry consulted) plus an explicit non-early verify() replay of every witness
criterion.discard: mirror pairs share one group and one split; a group is retained only if base and mirror both come out valid; duplicates of any frozen signature are discarded before evaluation
criterion.no_relaxation: if a family cannot reach six valid groups inside its budget the actual number and the per-candidate reasons are reported; no threshold is loosened
criterion.extra_constant_diagnostic: NOT part of the criterion: every supported candidate (0,3,7,9,12,16) is also run as a single constant and reported per world, because the requested five baselines cover only three of the six supported candidates; a retained world that a constant 12/16 still passes is reported as constant_passable and is never called constant-free
